description.value: Bouchons Bistro is an authentic French bistro operating in Kelowna's cultural district since 2004, helmed by Parisian chef Stephane Facon and offering classic regional dishes from escargots de Bourgogne and duck confit to bouillabaisse. The restaurant maintains a temperature-controlled Burgundy-style cellar stocked with over 750 bottles spanning Okanagan Valley producers and French appellations. Situated within walking distance of the Delta Grand Hotel, Kelowna Community Theatre, and Prospera Place, it serves as a polished evening dining destination for cyclists exploring the central Okanagan.

The dinner menu explicitly labels dishes with 'V' (vegetarian) and 'GF' (gluten-free) codes, confirming dietary accommodation. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
